lockFileMaintenance.description: Not automerged: Renovate does not apply minimumReleaseAge to lock file maintenance, so the regenerated web/package-lock.json can pick a transitive version published minutes earlier.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: govulncheck is `go install`ed by version inside workflow run blocks (ci.yaml and govulncheck.yaml). No built-in manager sees those lines, so without this the pin would never be bumped and would quietly go stale.
syft is installed by anchore/sbom-action/download-syft from a `syft-version:` input, which the github-actions manager does not extract.
The oras CLI version is a bare `version:` under oras-project/setup-oras. Its releases are tagged with a leading v, the input takes none.

promtool for the Helm Lint rules gate is downloaded from the Prometheus release URL in ci.yaml. The version appears twice in that URL; the match covers both, and Renovate replaces every occurrence inside it. The sha256 line below it is updated by hand.
buf for the generated-protobuf gate is downloaded from its release URL in ci.yaml. The sha256 line below it is updated by hand.
sqlc is run by `go run ...@$(SQLC_VERSION)` from the Makefile, which no built-in manager reads.

packageRules.description: Our own images. Their tags come from the chart appVersion at release time (values.yaml ships tag: ""), so Renovate must never touch them.
Majors always wait for a human, on the dependency dashboard rather than as open PRs. Tick the box on the dashboard issue to release one into a real PR.
Go module dependencies: one weekly PR, automerged once CI is green.
Go language/toolchain in go.mod. Patch level is where the crypto/tls and net/http CVE fixes land (GO-2026-5856 was exactly this) so it automerges; a language minor (1.26 -> 1.27) waits for a human.

The build toolchain moves as one PR because vite and @vitejs/plugin-react are mutually pinned: @vitejs/plugin-react@6 declares peer `vite: ^8.0.0` while @4 refuses vite 8, so a standalone bump of either cannot resolve a lockfile. @tailwindcss/vite@4 already accepts vite ^8 and vitest 4 is independently fine, but they belong in the same reviewable unit.
Base images of the four Dockerfiles. The Console image and Agent and controller images jobs build all four on every PR, so a green CI built the bump.
Images the chart values name, today the GeoIP sidecar (ghcr.io/maxmind/geoipupdate). CI only renders them and no job pulls or runs one, e2e included, so a green CI never executed the bump.
The golang base image follows go.mod's toolchain: a Go minor in the Dockerfiles joins the go.mod minor in the 'go toolchain' PR and waits for a human with it.

Tool versions pinned in a `with: version:` block: golangci-lint inside golangci-lint-action, the helm CLI inside azure/setup-helm. The github-actions manager already extracts these itself as depType uses-with, so no custom regex manager is needed and adding one would produce a second PR for the same line. A golangci-lint minor ships new linters and therefore new lint failures, and a helm minor changes chart rendering, so only patch automerges.

The groupName here is load-bearing: without it these deps keep the `github-actions` group from the rule above while carrying automerge:false, and a group is merged as a whole — one non-automergeable member parks every Action bump behind a human.
Release-only tooling: the release job is the only thing that runs it and PR CI never does, so nothing here automerges.

Actions only release.yaml or e2e.yaml run, and the tools they pin in `with:` (cosign-release, the goreleaser version, the kind CLI and node image, extracted as uses-with). CI calls neither workflow; goreleaser also runs in CI's images job, but as a snapshot with publish, sign and sbom skipped, so the release path still first runs on a tag. They join the release tooling group so the github-actions group stays automergeable.

requirements-docs.txt is the source of .github/requirements-docs.lock, and the pip-compile manager bumps it and regenerates the lock in one PR. pip_requirements would open a second PR for the same pins without the lock.

The Pages actions run only on a push to main: docs.yaml keeps the upload step and the deploy job off pull requests, so a green PR never executed the bump and its first run would be the production deploy.
Images of the e2e fixtures in e2e/testdata. Only the release's e2e job runs them, so a green PR never did.

promtool in the rules gate and the e2e fixture Prometheus are one Prometheus release and move together. The promtool sha256 in ci.yaml needs the new release's sha256sums.txt entry by hand, so the PR stays red until someone adds it.
buf and sqlc generate committed code, and CI fails on any diff from it. A bump needs `make proto` or `make sqlc` rerun, and buf's sha256 in ci.yaml updated by hand.

grpc 1.84.0 carries GO-2026-6443 (server panic on a request without :authority/Host, reachable from the controller's gRPC server); 1.83.x is not affected. Drop this rule once a release with the fix is out.
